All_Condition_Data_Deltas %>%
  filter(IRI <= 500) %>%
  mutate(Year = factor(YEAR_RECORD,
                       levels = c(2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024))) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  summarize(Mean_IRI = mean(IRI,na.rm = T)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = Year,y = Mean_IRI),stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Mean DC IRI By Year")
